population.source: exact Phase 2D3 subset3288 (822 per frozen band, unique phonology), identical for all three tasks

budget.optimizer: ONE shared AdamW over the union scope; fresh; checkpoint optimizer state never restored

naming.path: raw GloVe -> sem_to_h0 -> decoder -> dec_to_premotor -> frozen motor.proj

repetition.path: phonology -> ltm.encoder -> ltm.to_semantic = s_hat -> ltm.sem_to_h0 -> ltm.decoder -> ltm.dec_to_premotor -> frozen motor.proj
repetition.composition: naming_forward(model, comprehension_forward(model, .), .) -- the two validated Phase 2 forwards composed
repetition.not_used: losses.total_loss (carries gate/WM/alignment terms that would confound this pilot); WM route; gate

primary_readout.note: Autoregressive decoding: model's own previous output fed at each step.  Reflects free-generation accuracy; errors can propagate.

endpoint_preservation_report.secondary_note: descriptive only; does not control stopping and must not replace the primary >=0.95 criterion
